$comment: Every stylesheet producer in src — a function or method named *Styles returning a string — emits CSS whose rules can be present, correctly tokenised, and still never reach the element: a selector that stops matching, a specificity loss, an overpaint. jsdom has no cascade or layout engine and no e2e test reads rendered output, so test/visual is the only lane that can see that class. check:visual-coverage requires each producer to be EITHER rendered by a spec under test/visual (status 'tested' — proven, not asserted: the builder must be named in a spec, interpolated by one that is, or forwarded to by the producer's own body) OR classified 'backlog' (renderable by the harness, not yet — printed every run as visible debt). Keyed per producer rather than per file because a file-level status let a partly-covered file claim full coverage.

Skeleton limitations recorded in mergeWindowLayering.visual.test.ts
